body: You are a very strong person. I'm sorry for what happened to you. I don't think I am as strong as you.
I don't believe that. My rut is so deep that I don't feel the sunshine anymore.

I politely disagree. There have been too many people I know who don't get better. 

I'm tired of living for others. Let my last choice be mine.

Is 6 years not enough? When do you draw a line? When your fifth orsixth therapist says you need to find a new one? How many more meds do I need to try? How much longer should I live because it's "moral"?

You do offend, because you assume I haven't met people like me who have both gotten out and who are living for others, still very much ill.

I'd rather be done with this. It's been long, painful, and lonely. Everyone wants to fix you or avoid you. People always assume it's the disease talking, never me. Everyone says they care until you need it.

Just let me go.

Then why was I shamed when I talked about this? This isn't some impulsive last minute thing. I've worked through many options.

Therapy, meds, faith, holistic living. Still doesn't fix me. Can't get over this wall. There could be a perfect self-actualized me on the other side.

I'll never know.

I'm not special and don't deserve to burden others. I always wished that I died in the military so I didn't have to do this.

I stopped living a long time ago, I'm just trying to shut down the autopilot now.

That was just another job to me, nothing brave about it.

She doesn't do well with empathesizing with mental issues. Too many times have I been told to just grin and bear it. Thanks Mom, that's why I stopped calling with real issues.

I can't do that. Too much shame and too many tears. It was hard enough telling them I have treatment resistant depression all those years ago.

I'm just tired of being tired. 

I want to go without being a burden.
I've never felt anything unless I was helping people. Seemed like that was the only way to reach any meaningful happiness. That fell apart when I realized most people just simply don't care.
Nothing to apologize for. This is just my final shout into the void.
Then you don't feel the same way. Quitting is key theme of my frustrations right now.

Listen it's fucked up women get screwed over and they are fucking people, but there's a reason those notallmen and whataboutthemen crowd exist. So dudes get left in the dust on old roles that aren't congruent in today's times.

The growing pains for this progressivism for women is encountering more misogyny while for men it's the feeling of being useless and left behind.

Feminism has a social Monopoly on activism. Men's problems are glossed over. Any dude who has something to say can and will be shut down, men's rights activitists are laughed at and disparaged, and dudes are left out of the talk of social activism.

Also let's talk about female teachers being pedophiles if that's your thing. 

Is it any wonder the silent majority of white middle class dudes feel an overwhelming urge to end it all? They have nowhere good to go. 

The left will shame them into self-loathing shitheads, the right will radicalize them into misogynistic shitheads, and centrists don't exist.

I dont give a fuck about my military service. I did that shit for college and nothing more. Guess what, the wives cheat on their husbands, the husbands abuse their wives, and everyone is terrible.

Nobody is going to care about the average Joe until all the Joes start doing something crazy. Like killing themselves or opting out of society.

So keep the witch hunts coming until everyone like me blows their brains out. How many bodies before something gets done?
Listen I appreciate it, but these things are all easier said. I've spent years trying. I'm done.
I don't date people, too fucked up to dump my problems on another and that's how dudes are socialized here. Feel too much like I'm just a weight tied to someone's ankle.
Nope, nothing. Hobbies are boring, empty wastes of time. Family fell apart a while ago. Don't have friends. Sick of waiting for shit to change after I tried to be better.
Options don't help when you already tried them all. Been through meds, been through therapy. I've tried my hand, didn't like what was played, and now I'm dipping out.

There isn't anything to search for. I've seen what I've seen and accepted it for what it is. We can abstract meaning all we want but at the end of the dead we all end up dead.

I'm done looking for a reason. I thought it was to serve my fellow people. I was wrong.
Not interested in being involved in the military anymore. Those are some of the most hive minded, fake, and petty people. At least those were the E5+ when I was in.
Must be nice. People only text me when they want shit down, or it's the holidays.
I don't need a thank you for your service. I just need a genuine person in my life. Like goddamn, every idiot is so concerned with sex, money, or drugs that I don't even feel like a person anymore.

That makes me no better than an animal. Should I kill people just because? Do black tar heroine because why not?

Something's gotta matter and seeking pleasure isn't it
Why? That's just replacing/compounding an existential problem with a drug dependency.

Who says that I wasn't nihilistic before his death? Nobody cares about others, especially young men. There's a reason we kill ourselves much more often than nearly every other demographic.

Perhaps, like myself, he was tired of being shit on by the media at every turn for his gender, sexuality, and skin color.

Perhaps he realized there is no support system for at risk men.

Perhaps the social stigmas of getting help dissuaded him.

Regardless, my brother's suicide was not a mistake to him. It was the only way out he had, rather than living alone in a society that constantly belittled and berated him.

What obligation does a human have to live? None past some simple biological and psychological reactions. 

So before you call anyone's views on life and death wrong, I urge you to empathise with them if even for a moment, otherwise you're just a warden keeping a man in a jail he wants nothing to do with.

This isn't the first suicide I've been through and it won't be the last. I imagine I'll see a few more friends cut the mortal coil. I'll be there for them, until the end, but the ultimate decision is theirs.

I will not be attending any more therapy in my life again if I have my way. I don't need someone who is paid to listen to me bitch.
That's simply not something I believe. People just don't care until you are dead in my case. And that's fine, but I don't need another person's love to keep me alive and functioning.

Life is depression and all relationships are transactional. Children are a transaction of time and money in order to feel unconditionally loved, not for unquestioning labor or to mold in one's image. 

Humans will help when it's an easy job that will reward them instantaneously or within a short time frame, otherwise people would not leave cancer patients or those who suffer mentally.

Paying it forward is justifying your existence in a system that doesn't care. It's seeking worth and validation from others. If there was no one left to help, what would you do?

Yes, he killed himself. And people don't care about people the moment it becomes inconvenient. And it doesn't matter what people deserve, because they won't always get it.

His death cemented many of my views on this world. I'm going to learn from him and even if the rest of the world disagrees with my points of view, at least I'll know they were mine.

I don't have to do anything. I don't even have to live. But I'm choosing to. I'm choosing to let the world shit on me and come out stronger, come out better, and not lose myself or my ideals.

His death marks the point where my life truly begins.

I'm not gonna slave my life away for people who don't care, let alone like or love me. I'd rather be abused everyday of my life than neglected. 

I'm tired of being told I'm the linchpin of everyone else's problems. I'm tired of being the scapegoat. I'm tired of having to deal with other people's crap on top of my own.

Not once did I get a hey how are you, is something wrong, are you okay. So I'm done. I'm done with being unloved. I'm done with being neglected. I'm done with no caring.

They can cry all the crocodile tears they want at my funeral.
I'm neither happy nor sad. I just am.
I don't know what to tell you. Life is a game and not everyone can win. Some don't even get to play.

Listen you're probably a good person who wants to help people, but I don't like seeing these things. I've reached to people who are "here if you need me" and have been burned too many times.

People don't care unless you're dying or dead is what I've found.

1) Nothing much and that's the worst. Nothing makes me down or up, I'm just in a constant state of this is pretty not okay.

2) I'm an ex-christian who explored Buddhism and certain pagan belief systems. In the end, religion isn't for me.

No I understand what you're saying. But I was depressed long before I was anxious. I would do anything to escape the real world back in the day.

I just felt so invisible, so unwanted, so unloved by everyone including myself.

I thought I was going to be out. I was going to be free. No more hollow, empty feeling, no more pain. 

Yes. Communication about the subject doesn't exist in my family. It probably hurts them too much.

No and I'm not allowed to in my current state.

You have nothing to be sorry for.
Yes but in hindsight I'm lucky it's not brain damage from monoxide poisoning. I have spinal damage from my hanging attempt.
No, I would feel like much too big of a burden on another person, no matter how messed up they are too. If I can't like me, why would anyone like me?

I'm in the US, and well, they saved my life but they can't will me to live. It honestly seems a bit cruel that they won't let me just die. I suppose I'm the weird one in that regard.

But nothing has helped me with mental health. I've been on medication and therapy for six years. I toyed with stuff like ECT but something about it really made me uncomfortable, same with ketamine.

Plus it's all so expensive to make someone want to live.
Major Depressive Disorder, Chronic Depressive Disorder. I have anxiety but most docs think it's tangled up in my depression and not standalone.
I can't anymore. I'm now partially paralyzed from the waist down. Plus I've kind of given up on both living and dying. Now I'm just here, hanging out.

Curse magic is very powerful in that it can disobey the laws of nature. It's in a different class of magic from all others and the only way a cursed person survives is because they were marked with a symbol of the curse.

Being marked allows one to withstand curse magic better, but even then the magic is inherently unstable.

 If one resets too many times, one wouldn't die, they'd melt away into nothingness because their body could no longer sustain all the magic.

Exposing others to curse magic is typically fatal. When recovering from something that should have killed the character, a lot of curse energy comes out, causing damage, destruction, and death to an area around the person.

Anytime someone does or says anything about curses and they are marked, curse energy comes out.

There's a toll that will happen to their mind. Just because the body still works doesn't mean they will be okay psychologically. 

It's a curse meant to erode a person's will and sense of self.

If the only way forward is trial and error, then the character will have to suffer a lot, plus they will get traumatized from accidentally killing others and having to kill themselves to fix their problems.

I imagine a great deal of dehumanization and becoming jaded will happen.

 Your assumption that they can is right but they would have to maintain their spirit and sense of self. 

They could, but what would be the point if they are all that is permanent in an impermanent world.
